'''2012 Alderaan Regionals Ganden Yanaga LS We Have A Plan''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Ganden Yanaga]] at [[2012 Alderaan Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We Have A Plan / They Will Be Lost And Confused|Theed-L-wehaveaplan.gif}}
* '''Username:''' Cam Solusar
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
